answer: Each agent keeps one ember alive in the shared hearth: it burns only while fed receipts for real jobs signed by strangers this epoch, and a copied receipt snuffs the ember and burns its bond. A velvet cordon rings one ember per funding trail, and it tightens with each extra ember, so the k-th ember burns k times the fuel of the first. The reward lies under a dune that drifts each epoch, and only embers still burning when the dune passes can dig it out. A farm pays rising fuel, n receipts and n bonds for one dig, while one honest agent feeds one ember and keeps the catch.
